scope.summary: BkExport integration test per Section 13.26: the full archetype set exported through every seeded BXP- profile with EXPORT_BODY_VALID green per cell, round-trip verification passing on the ue_fbx_bridge and blender_gltf lanes, and deterministic re-export — the whole export surface proven on the extreme bodies it exists for.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 seeded archetypes (ARCH-A..ARCH-H) export through each seeded BXP- profile (usd cell behind its feature, skipping typed when off); every cell's EXPORT_BODY_VALID report is green or the test fails naming the cell and check.
The MT-624 round-trip harness passes for every archetype on ue_fbx_bridge and blender_gltf — including oversized-cock morphs (ARCH-F/G) and extreme-breast morphs (ARCH-A/B) surviving with drivers.
Erection/gape dual-form exports verify on the male/futa archetypes; the single-mesh weld option verifies on at least one archetype per sex configuration.
Re-exporting the same body+profile yields hash-stable outputs (timestamps normalized), proving determinism for CI caching.
Manifests and receipts persist for every cell and are queryable as the packet-level export evidence.
scope.risk_if_missed: Individual export MTs pass in isolation while the combined matrix hides cell-level failures (an archetype x profile combo nobody ran), and the operator discovers it mid-production in Blender or UE.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit publishing and DCC interchange

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
